purpose: Original KSEAB-style grammar practice focused on transformation and usage patterns.

questions.question: Change into reported speech: Riya said, "I have completed my project."
questions.answer: Riya said that she had completed her project.

questions.question: Change into reported speech: The teacher said to Arun, "Do not waste your time."
questions.answer: The teacher advised Arun not to waste his time.

questions.question: Change into passive voice: The committee will announce the results tomorrow.
questions.answer: The results will be announced by the committee tomorrow.

questions.question: Change into passive voice: Someone has stolen my bicycle.
questions.answer: My bicycle has been stolen.

questions.question: Rewrite using the comparative degree: No other metal is as useful as iron.
questions.answer: Iron is more useful than any other metal.

questions.question: Rewrite using the positive degree: Mumbai is one of the largest cities in India.
questions.answer: Very few cities in India are as large as Mumbai.

questions.question: Frame a question so that the underlined answer is elicited: The students visited Mysuru during the vacation.
questions.answer: Where did the students visit during the vacation?

questions.question: Frame a question for the answer: She has lived here for five years.
questions.answer: How long has she lived here?

questions.question: Complete meaningfully: If I had known about the meeting, __________.
questions.answer: I would have attended it.

questions.question: Complete meaningfully: If you work hard, __________.
questions.answer: you will succeed.

questions.question: Combine using 'although': He was tired. He continued working.
questions.answer: Although he was tired, he continued working.

questions.question: Combine using 'because': The match was postponed. It was raining heavily.
questions.answer: The match was postponed because it was raining heavily.

questions.question: Join using 'unless': You must hurry. You will miss the bus.
questions.answer: Unless you hurry, you will miss the bus.

questions.question: Join using 'so...that': The box was very heavy. I could not lift it.
questions.answer: The box was so heavy that I could not lift it.

questions.question: Rewrite in the simple past: She writes a letter to her friend.
questions.answer: She wrote a letter to her friend.

questions.question: Rewrite in the present perfect: They finished the work.
questions.answer: They have finished the work.

questions.question: Add a suitable prefix to form the opposite of 'possible'.
questions.answer: impossible

questions.question: Add a suitable suffix to 'kind' to form a noun.
questions.answer: kindness

questions.question: Correct the error: Neither of the boys have completed the assignment.
questions.answer: Neither of the boys has completed the assignment.

questions.question: Correct the sentence: He is good in mathematics and lives in an village near Mysuru.
questions.answer: He is good at mathematics and lives in a village near Mysuru.
